column1: # Dictum coding-term eval corpus. Tab-separated: id, split, keywords, text.
# The text column is BOTH the reference transcript and the prompt you read aloud.
# Read it naturally, as if dictating to a coding agent - do not over-enunciate,
# and do not read the punctuation aloud. Record with:
# The keywords column lists terms that must appear in the FINAL injected text,
# spelled and cased exactly as written here. Empty for prose controls.
#   lib    out-of-repo library / tool / API vocabulary - the enumerable set that a
#          term table and a hotword list can own outright.
#   repo   an identifier from THIS repo, reachable through the spoken symbol cue.
#          The text carries the cue word "symbol" because that is how the feature
#          is actually invoked; with no cue it is inert by design.
#   gated  an identifier the precision gating deliberately refuses to glue back
#          together. The keyword is the SPOKEN form, which must survive untouched -
#          a "correction" here would be the bug.
#   prose  no target terms at all. Scores corruption rather than accuracy: the
#          pipeline must not change what the recognizer heard. Carries every spoken
#          form demoted out of the rule table for colliding with ordinary English.
